history.summary: A 1,529sqft 99-yr leasehold 3BR in the 1,006-unit Mandarin Gardens, built 1986 — only ~59 years of lease remaining and appreciating just 2.9%/yr on a deep 140-txn series. The 2023 en-bloc collapsed at 42% support against an 80% threshold, so the redevelopment thesis is dead for the foreseeable future and the lease decay now dominates.
history.rating_rationale: 40-year-old leasehold with ~59 years left is firmly in lease-decay territory: 2.9%/yr appreciation (140 txn, high confidence) trails inflation-adjusted alternatives, financing/CPF use tightens as lease shortens, and the failed 2023 en-bloc (only 42% support) removes the one catalyst that could have justified the entry. Even at a low $1,177 psf, this is a depreciating-runway asset for a 5-7yr investment hold.
red_flags: ~59 years lease remaining — CPF/financing restrictions tighten over hold period
Failed 2023 en-bloc (42% vs 80% needed) — redevelopment thesis dead near-term
